review.assessment: The change guards against a ZeroDivisionError when iterating over windows with no recorded values by defaulting `mean` to 0.0. This prevents premature termination of the roll-up, allowing the pipeline to finish processing all remaining samples and restoring accurate volume reporting. The logic is safe: it leaves non-empty window calculations untouched and uses an existing pattern for handling empty data (`peak = max(...) if window.values else None`). No defects were found in this change.
